data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 reduces to SRC_005 because both solve D(n)=792 by identical piecewise-linear summation; SRC_005's closed-form D(n)=9+180+(n−99)×3 is an algebraic simplification of SRC_003's step-by-step narrative ('9+180=189, 792−189=603, 603/3=201, 99+201=300'). It is REFUTED IF SRC_005 uses a derivation whose left-hand-side is not D(n)=792, or if SRC_003's '99+201' total is shown to fail the additivity axiom required by the compact formula (i.e., if the first 99 pages are a sub-count not retained in the final physical total).
